dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli on the upper mid-flank display sharp pixel gradients transitioning from dark outer perimeters to high-intensity white/grey centers, particularly a cluster of three interconnected rings near the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity white blobs located on the lower posterior flank and the anterior shoulder region, lacking internal gradients or central voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the upper flank form an elongated irregular quadrilateral, while three primary high-intensity blobs on the posterior form an acute scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, dark, curved keratinized structures (claws) are visible on the anterior edge of the protruding pectoral flipper.
